node.title: L1 full-locator Pade section for all cofactor degrees
node.statement: For every exact shell degree, put w=a-k, e=deg(U)-a, and d=e+w with no restriction on e. For a full reversed monic locator Lhat, deg(U-LQ)<k is equivalent to the w quotient coefficients [T^(e+1..e+w)] Uhat/Lhat vanishing; the first e+1 quotient coefficients recover Q. Exact shells are exactly the split locators in this full-locator Pade section whose recovered cofactors satisfy the complement gcd guard. If e<k, the section is the prefix Pade graph times F^(k-e) and has exactly q^k ambient locator points. If e>=k, the same section remains exact as the reciprocal continues past locator degree a, but no cardinality, codimension, transversality, or row-sharp bound is asserted.
